mapper.sql: dc.*, p.name AS parent_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(o.code ORDER BY o.code SEPARATOR ',') FROM mdm_defect_code_op dco JOIN mdm_op o ON o.id = dco.op_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE dco.defect_code_id = dc.id AND dco.deleted = 0) AS op_names, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mc.name ORDER BY mc.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM mdm_defect_code_mat_cat dcmc JOIN mdm_mat_cat mc ON mc.id = dcmc.mat_cat_id AND mc.deleted = 0 WHERE dcmc.defect_code_id = dc.id AND dcmc.deleted = 0) AS mat_cat_names
FROM mdm_defect_code dc LEFT JOIN mdm_defect_code p ON p.id = dc.parent_id AND p.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT op_id FROM mdm_defect_code_op WHERE defect_code_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY op_id ASC
SELECT mat_cat_id FROM mdm_defect_code_mat_cat WHERE defect_code_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY mat_cat_id ASC
